svg.title: XC3800 + MCP2021: reported working build: breadboard
svg.text: Component pins in labelled holes; jumpers connect only their endpoints. Not to physical scale.
Assumes continuous power rails. Verify rail breaks and board pin labels before connecting power.
U2 body overhangs the left edge.
As built; not independently measured or electrically certified
Rail drawing is symbolic: check continuity between the upper circuit and the ESP32 ground connection.
The wiring table in hardware.md lists every jumper, including those represented by matching W labels.
